name: 计划模式看守
description: Puts the plan-mode collaboration rules ahead of every prompt Orca submits to an agent, with Settings under the plugin to turn them off.

settings.title: 注入计划模式规则
settings.description: 开：Orca 代发给 Agent 的提示（启动提示、orchestration 派发、orca terminal send 等）前自动附加计划模式规则。关：原样发送。你在终端里亲手输入的提示不受影响。
